messages:
maria-partnerships: Quick heads-up — CipherOps joint announcement rehearsal set for Wed 1pm PT. Goal: dry-run talking points + confirm SSO/SCIM/KMS readiness for the marketplace listing. Please drop owners + one bullet status by EOD. :calendar: 
aj-security: I can own SSO + SCIM status. Current: SAML metadata exchanged and test IdP flow passes in staging. SCIM endpoints exist but user sync mapping needs confirmation from CipherOps. KMS/HSM is the unknown.
oliver-sre: Ops side — we need a simple runbook for cutover and a fallback model if HSM BYOK fails. Also want a target RTO for key rotation test.
sophia-marketing: Marketing needs embargo window and approved logo assets. Also a single-line blurb for the announcement (we can craft based on feature parity). Who signs off on co-branding? @liam-legal? :megaphone:
liam-legal: I can review co-branding and data processing notes. Need copy of any customer-facing screenshots and confirmation that no customer data will be included in the announcement. Also need the partner's logo in SVG and a signed co-marketing MSA or addendum.
cipherops-jane: Thanks — CipherOps status: SAML: PASS (staging). SCIM: work-in-progress; we have the endpoint and schema, but need attribute mapping for "department" and "role". HSM/KMS: partner HSM vendor integration is scheduled next week; BYOK flow prototype exists but hasn't been validated in our marketplace harness. Ops can share a test key ID tomorrow.
cipherops-ops: quick note from our side — sample SCIM payload and test endpoint:
```
POST https://scim.cipherops.example/v2/Users
Content-Type: application/json
Authorization: Bearer <scim-token>
{
  "userName": "j.smith@example.com",
  "name": { "givenName": "Jane", "familyName": "Smith" },
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],
  "urn:custom:role": "engineer"
}
```
cipherops-ops: we'll provide a test token and a mapping doc by EOD.
maria-partnerships: Perfect. For the rehearsal agenda: 1) quick intros 2) product demo clip 3) integration status (SSO/SCIM/KMS) 4) runbook/fallback walkthrough 5) press/embargo notes 6) Q&A. Please confirm presenters.
aj-security: I'll present the SSO/SCIM bit and the verification checklist.
oliver-sre: I'll run through the fallback and escalation steps + where to find logs/traces (we'll point to the marketplace trace link).
sophia-marketing: I'll handle press embargo timeline. Can we agree on embargo 48 hours before go-live?
liam-legal: 48 hours is ok to start, but need partner sign-off. I'll ping legal ops to prep the addendum template.
cipherops-jane: We'll confirm BYOK/HSM test results by Tues EOD and the SCIM mapping so you can validate. Also comfortable with 48h embargo pending legal.
deploy-bot: Reminder: add announcement to the "marketplace-release" calendar once legal signs off.
maria-partnerships: Thanks all — action items: aj: SCIM mapping checklist; cipherops-ops: test token + KMS test key id; liam: draft addendum; sophia: embargo plan. We'll sync 30m before rehearsal. :thumbsup:
